items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Hiram Brown by the interviewee (Mose Allison). The name appears only in the interviewer's questions regarding the album title 'The Transfiguration of Hiram Brown'.

ctx.x: One has one of the best titles ever, The Transfiguration of Hiram Brown.
Oh, yeah. I liked that record. I made it with Jerry Segal and Addison Farmer, downtown in a big room...
